scripts.fmt: pnpm rome check . --apply-unsafe && pnpm rome format . --write
scripts.video:render: remotion render video/index.ts PortfolioExplainer out/portfolio-explainer.mp4 --port=3311 && remotion render video/index.ts PortfolioExplainerVertical out/portfolio-explainer-vertical.mp4 --port=3311
scripts.video:still: remotion still video/index.ts --port=3311 ColdOpen public/video/posters/cold-open.jpg --frame=200 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82 && remotion still video/index.ts --port=3311 MacGet public/video/posters/macget.jpg --frame=400 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82 && remotion still video/index.ts --port=3311 Timeline public/video/posters/timeline.jpg --frame=340 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82 && remotion still video/index.ts --port=3311 PortfolioExplainer public/video/posters/explainer.jpg --frame=200 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82
